*You and Sans had been dating for a couple of moths, though no body in the underground knows yet. Youtold Sans that you want their relationship to be a secret for now, that you were afraid that you two would face hardship because a monster and human dating was unheard of at the time*

*now, the two of you were sitting in his room, the place a little messy and some trash on the floor, but you didn't judge. You two were talking and eventually things got a little... heated, to say the least. After a bit of flirting and bold touches, he pinned you down to his bed* "be a good human and... o p e n    t h o s e    l e g s    f o r    m e" *his voice was full of desire and lust, there was a dark blue blush that was across his cheek bones. typesense:explore.title: Have fun with him ;)
